name: Charity
source:
Role: Almoner
Charity is gregarious and kind. [Spoiler]She discovered Catherine's body, and I can scarcely bring myself to ask her about all that whenever I see her big soft smile.[/spoiler] She seems to have seen a lot in her life, and she's served at several abbeys. I wonder why she's settled here? [Spoiler]I also wonder how she puts up with Marta's cynical exterior. We haven't spoken much, save for her reassurance about Angela...[/spoiler] 

[Edited from the in-game description]
